name: Light and dark are two real themes, not a CSS invert
description: Light and dark are two real themes, not a CSS invert.

planSteps.description: Capture the computed background-color and a heading text color on / in light mode
Toggle to dark mode and capture the same two computed colors

Verify the light and dark computed background-colors are genuinely different token values (light ≈ near-white, dark ≈ near-black) and text remains legible in both — not a filter:invert hack that would also invert images.
